title: Marie Eline Madsen krones som enstemmig All-American for anden sæson i træk
original:
Marie Eline Madsen har for anden sæson i træk fået den højeste hæder i amerikansk collegegolf. **Skriver universitetets hjemmeside** blev hun udnævnt til *unanimous All-American*, hvilket betyder, at alle stemmer i udvalget var enige om hendes placering. Derudover blev hun også valgt til *WGCA All-America Second Team* og *Golfweek All-America Third Team*. Hun har desuden været en fast del af *All-ACC Team* for andet år i træk, hvilket gør hende til blot den fjerde spiller i North Carolina States historie, der har opnået denne bedrift i to sæsoner i træk.

## En sæson i topklasse

Madsen har i den netop afsluttede sæson imponeret med et gennemsnit på **70,88 slag pr. runde**, hvilket er det laveste gennemsnit i skolens historie på én sæson. Hun har desuden præsteret **24 runder på par eller bedre** og **11 runder i 60’erne**, hvilket understreger hendes konsistente høje niveau. Med **tre turneringssejre**, **syv top-10-placeringer** og **ti top-20-placeringer i 11 turneringer** har hun været en af de mest stabile spillere i hele ligaen.

Hendes præstationer har også givet hende en placering som **nummer 26 på Scoreboard Powered by Clippd Ranking** og **nummer 22 på World Amateur Golf Ranking**, hvilket placerer hende blandt de bedste amatørspillere globalt.

## Fremtidige udfordringer og muligheder

Madsen har allerede markeret sig som en af de mest succesrige spillere i North Carolina States golfhistorie. Med **fem karrieresejre**, herunder tre i den seneste sæson, har hun sat en ny skolerekord for flest turneringssejre. Hun har desuden **15 top-10-placeringer** og **21 top-20-placeringer** på blot 23 turneringer, hvilket vidner om hendes evne til at præstere på højeste niveau.

Udover sine kollegiale præstationer har Madsen også fået muligheden for at repræsentere **Team International** ved **Arnold Palmer Cup** i Irland i sommer. Denne invitation er en stor ære og giver hende mulighed for at konkurrere på internationalt niveau.

Med en to-årig scoring på **71,06 i gennemsnit** og fortsat udvikling i sit spil, ser fremtiden lys ud for den danske golfstjerne. Hendes evne til at levere under pres og hendes konstante forbedringer gør hende til en spiller, der fortsat vil være med i toppen af amerikansk collegegolf.

title: Chigozie Oge-Evans named to Patriot League preseason team
original:
Georgetown University defensive lineman Chigozie Oge-Evans has been named to the 2026 Patriot League Preseason All-League Team, marking another milestone in a promising career with the Blue & Gray. The Oxford-born senior enters his final collegiate campaign after a 2025 season that saw him establish new career highs while anchoring one of the league’s most resilient defensive units.

## A season of personal bests

The 2025 campaign proved to be Oge-Evans’ most productive to date, as the defensive lineman started all 12 games and delivered career-best figures across key defensive metrics. According to the university’s athletics website, he recorded 27 total tackles, including 18 solo stops and nine assisted tackles, while adding four sacks for a 26-yard loss. His disruptive presence in the trenches was further underlined by a pass breakup and a forced fumble, contributions that helped Georgetown’s defence remain competitive throughout the year.

Oge-Evans’ performances did not go unnoticed, with the team’s website highlighting his relentless effort and dedication to improvement. The senior has spent the past three years refining his craft, committing to daily progress both physically and technically. His leadership has also been recognised, as he was named to the 2025 All-Patriot League Second Team on defence, cementing his status as one of the conference’s most reliable defensive players.

## Leading from the front

Beyond his on-field contributions, Oge-Evans has taken on a key leadership role within the Georgetown programme. The team’s website notes his commitment to leading the squad both on and off the pitch, a responsibility he carries as a team captain. Head Coach Rob Sgarlata praised the athlete’s impact, stating: "Chigozie is one of the most disruptive defensive players we have had at Georgetown. He plays with relentless effort and has dedicated himself to improving each day over the past three years. As a team captain, he works each day to lead our program both on and off the field. I am excited to see him compete as he starts his senior year."

## Looking ahead to 2026

With the preseason accolade secured, Oge-Evans now turns his focus to the 2026 campaign, where he will aim to build on last season’s progress. Georgetown enters the new term with ambitions of climbing the Patriot League standings, having been listed as DL, 6' 3", Senior in the team’s official preseason materials. The Blue & Gray were tied for eighth in the 2026 Patriot League Preseason Poll with Fordham and ahead of Bucknell in 10th, setting the stage for a competitive season ahead.

As Oge-Evans prepares for his final year in college football, his combination of disruptive play in the trenches and natural leadership qualities makes him a cornerstone of Georgetown’s defensive plans. With his preseason recognition serving as validation of his hard work, the Oxford native will be aiming to translate that momentum into another standout campaign for the Blue & Gray.

title: Nathan Woodham shines as Lamar golf surges in academics
original:
Nathan Woodham has marked his senior season at Lamar University with a performance that balances sporting excellence with academic rigour. The Camberley-born golfer, now in his third year with the Cardinals, has delivered a campaign that places him among the nation’s elite in both the classroom and on the course.

## A season of steady progress

Woodham’s consistency has been the defining feature of his 2025-26 campaign. According to the university’s website, he recorded the second-lowest stroke average in Division I golf at 72.8 over 33 rounds. His tally of 15 rounds at par or better underscores a reliability that has kept him in contention across multiple tournaments. The standout individual performance came at the Border Olympics, where he carded a season-low 67 in the second round to finish tied for fourth overall.

The Golden Nugget Invitational provided another highlight, with Woodham posting the best 54-hole score of his season at 209. These results contributed to a strong team showing, with the Lamar men’s golf team among the national leaders in academic recognition.

## All-conference honours and academic triple crown

Woodham’s contributions were recognised beyond the course, as he earned second-team All-Southland Conference honours. The accolade capped a season in which he balanced the demands of Division I athletics with his studies in physics. His academic achievements were equally impressive, with a 3.76 GPA securing a place on the Southland Conference All-Academic team, the Dean’s List and the President’s List.

The university’s website reports that Lamar’s men’s golf programme was one of the most decorated in the country for academic excellence, with six players earning Golf All-America Scholar status. Woodham’s inclusion among them reflects both his individual commitment and the programme’s emphasis on dual success.

## A fitting finale to a British golfer’s journey

As a senior from Camberley, Woodham’s season has provided a fitting conclusion to his time in Beaumont. His ability to grind out steady rounds under pressure has been a hallmark of his collegiate career, while his academic record demonstrates the discipline required to excel in a demanding environment. With his final year now complete, his legacy at Lamar is one of consistency, resilience and the pursuit of excellence in both sport and study.

The Cardinals’ men’s golf team will now look ahead to the postseason, where Woodham’s form and leadership will be crucial in their pursuit of further success. For the Surrey native, the focus shifts to the next chapter, though his impact on the programme will not be forgotten.

title: Louis Bowden triumphs for Baylor after ITA sweep
original:
British senior Louis Bowden has secured a standout finish at the ITA National Summer Championships, sweeping both the singles and doubles titles to join Baylor University’s tennis programme on a high.

The Portsmouth athlete, who competes in his final year at Baylor, delivered a dominant run through the 32-player singles draw before claiming the doubles crown alongside August Brostrom Poulsen. The victory keeps the doubles title in Baylor hands for a third consecutive year, following Luc Koenig and Luis Jose Nakamine’s win in 2025 and Brostrom Poulsen’s partnership with Marko Miladinovic in 2024.

## A flawless singles campaign

Bowden’s singles campaign was defined by clinical performances, with the British athlete dropping just one set en route to the final. He overcame Stiles Brockett 6-1, 5-7, 10-7 in a tightly contested championship match, capping a run that included victories over Jaivanth Sathish, Oscar Corwin and August Brostrom Poulsen in the semi-final.

The team’s website reports that Bowden’s consistency and precision under pressure were key to his success, with his 6-1, 6-1 demolition of Sathish in the round of 16 setting the tone for the tournament.

## Doubles dominance with Brostrom Poulsen

Teaming up with Brostrom Poulsen, Bowden added the doubles title to his haul, defeating Quintan Van Wijk and Anesh Jayasundera 6-3, 7-6(7) in the final. Their partnership also saw off John Riordan and Ryan Battaglia in the quarter-finals, demonstrating a seamless blend of strategy and execution.

As champions, Bowden and Brostrom Poulsen each earned main-draw wild cards into the ITA All-American Championship this autumn, a prestigious event that will further test their form.

## A landmark week for Baylor tennis

The ITA National Summer Championships, held from 8-11 August 2026, featured a 32-player singles draw and a 16-team doubles draw, with $20,000 in total prize money on offer. Baylor’s tennis programme will now look ahead to the ITA All-American Championship, where Bowden will aim to build on his summer success.

title: August Brostrøm Poulsen vinder ITA-double før studiestart
original:
August Brostrøm Poulsen fra København har allerede sat sit aftryk i sin første amerikanske sæson som friskmand på Baylor Universitys tennishold. Den 20-årige dansker imponerede ved ITA National Summer Championships i begyndelsen af august, hvor han sammen med holdkammeraten Louis Bowden sikrede sig double-titlen og samtidig nåede semifinalen i single-disciplinen.

## En stærk debut i double
Brostrom Poulsen og Bowden dominerede turneringen i double, hvor de på vej mod finalen blandt andet besejrede John Riordan og Ryan Battaglia med cifrene 6-3, 6-4 i kvartfinalen. I semifinalen fik de walkover, da modstanderne Kishan Kersten og Meethre Barot meldte afbud. I finalen stod det klart, at Baylors førstehold var det stærkeste, da duoen slog Quintan Van Wijk og Anesh Jayasundera med 6-3, 7-6(7) i en tæt kamp.

Sejren betød, at Brostrom Poulsen og Bowden hver især sikrede sig et wildcard til den kommende ITA All-American Championship, som afholdes senere på efteråret. Dermed fortsætter Baylors stime med at vinde turneringen, da holdet også vandt double-titlen i 2025 med Luc Koenig og Luis Jose Nakamine samt i 2024 med Brostrom Poulsens storebror, Oskar Brostrøm Poulsen, og Marko Miladinovic.

## Næsten i single-finalen
I single-turneringen viste Brostrom Poulsen også klasse, da han som eneste friskmand nåede semifinalen. Her måtte han dog se sig slået af holdkammeraten Bowden med 6-7(2), 4-6 i to tætte sæt. Bowden havde netop brug for et tiebreak for at komme videre i ottendedelsfinalen, hvilket understreger den hårde konkurrence blandt Baylors egne spillere.

Turneringen blev afholdt på Baylors eget Hurd Tennis Center i perioden 8.-11. august 2026 og havde en 32-deltagers singleturnering samt en 16-holds doubleturnering. Med en samlet præmiesum på 20.000 dollars var det en prestigefyldt begivenhed, der satte skub i den amerikanske sommerturneringssæson.

For Brostrom Poulsen markerer præstationen endnu en milepæl i en tidlig karriere, der allerede viser potentiale for mere. Med en bror, der tidligere har vundet turneringen i double, og nu en selv som dobbelt mester, er familien Brostrøm Poulsen godt på vej til at sætte sit præg på amerikansk college-tennis.

## Ubesejret i double

I kvartfinalen slog Brostrøm Poulsen og Bowden John Riordan og Ryan Battaglia 6-3, 6-4. Semifinalen kom parret videre fra uden kamp, da Kishan Kersten og Meethre Barot måtte trække sig, mens finalen mod Quintan Van Wijk og Anesh Jayasundera endte 6-3, 7-6(7).

Titlen giver begge spillere et wildcard til hovedturneringen ved ITA All-American Championship til efteråret.

## Semifinale mod double-makker

I single nåede Brostrøm Poulsen semifinalen, hvor modstanderen blev netop Louis Bowden, som han vandt double-turneringen samme med. Danskeren tvang første sæt i tiebreak, men tabte 6-7(2), 4-6. Bowden vandt efterfølgende hele singleturneringen.

## Storebroren vandt for 2 år siden

Baylor har nu vundet double-titlen i turneringen tre år i træk. Luc Koenig og Luis Jose Nakamine vandt i 2025, og den i 2024 gik Marko Miladinovic og Oskar Brostrøm Poulsen - August Brostrøm Poulsens storebror - hele vejen.

Turneringen blev spillet 8.-11. august 2026 på Baylors eget Hurd Tennis Center med 32 spillere i single, 16 par i double og en samlet præmiesum på 20.000 dollars.

title: Libby Pole fires UTRGV to season-opening shutout win
original:
The University of Texas Rio Grande Valley women’s soccer team kicked off their 2026 season with a hard-fought 1-0 shutout victory over Tarleton State University, with British midfielder Libby Pole delivering the decisive moment. The Vaqueros’ senior playmaker, from Somerton in England, marked her return with a goal that extended her career tally and provided the platform for a disciplined defensive display.

## Pole’s strike seals narrow win

Pole’s strike in the 50th minute broke a deadlock that had seen Tarleton dominate possession but struggle to convert their chances. The goal, her second in her collegiate career, came after a swift counter-attack led by the UTRGV midfield, with junior Isabella Burtini providing the assist from a long lob on the left wing. The university’s website reports that Pole connected cleanly from the left corner of the net, capitalising on a rare opportunity against a defence under sustained pressure.

Tarleton, who outshot UTRGV 19-5 and registered eight shots on target to the Vaqueros’ five, found their rhythm early but were repeatedly thwarted by a back line marshalled by Pole and her defensive colleagues. The British midfielder’s positional awareness and work rate were pivotal in both defence and attack, as UTRGV navigated a physical encounter that saw both teams receive yellow cards.

## Defensive backbone shines

Sophomore goalkeeper Mariana Amezcua delivered a career-high eight saves, including a crucial clean sheet in her first match as a Vaquero. Her performance underlined the collective resilience that defined the evening, with the defence bending but never breaking despite Tarleton’s relentless pressure. Freshman Yarisah Perez and Melany Gallegos both received their first collegiate yellow cards, while Tarleton’s Grace St. Berry was also cautioned, alongside UTRGV’s Burtini.

The victory sets the tone for a campaign that begins in earnest for UTRGV, who return to their home ground at the UTRGV Soccer and Track & Field Complex for Sunday’s fixture against Texas A&M International. title: Marie Eline Madsen på ANNIKA Award Watch List efter rekordstærk sæson
original:
Den danske golfspiller **Marie Eline Madsen** fra North Carolina State University har indledt den nye sæson med et markant skridt mod endnu en toppræstation. Hun er blevet udvalgt til den prestigefyldte ANNIKA Award Preseason Watch List for 2026-27, hvilket understreger hendes status som en af de mest lovende collegespillere i landet. Ifølge universitetets hjemmeside er hun én af blot 25 kvindelige golfspillere på listen, der samler de bedste collegespillere i USA.

## En sæson i topklasse

Madsen leverede i den forgangne sæson endnu en imponerende præstation for NC State, hvor hun satte skolens rekord med et gennemsnit på 70,88 slag pr. runde. Hun viste sig som en nøglespiller på holdet, der sikrede sig tre turneringssejre – herunder sejre ved Cougar Classic, Daniel Island Invitational og City of Oaks Collegiate. Hendes bedste runde i sæsonen var en 15-under-par 198 (69-67-62) ved Cougar Classic, hvilket også er en 54-hullers rekord for skolen.

Ud over sine sejre markerede Madsen sig med 24 runder på par eller bedre og 11 runder i 60’erne i løbet af sæsonen. Hun sluttede blandt de ti bedste syv gange og blandt de 20 bedste ti gange, hvilket bidrog til holdets samlede succes. Med 71,06 i karrieregennemsnit og 15 top-10-placeringer i sin tid på NC State har hun cementeret sin position som en af de mest stabile spillere i divisionen.

## International erfaring og holdets præstationer

Madsen har ikke blot imponeret på det nationale niveau, men også på den internationale scene. Hun repræsenterede Team International ved Arnold Palmer Cup, hvor hun bidrog med en afgørende point i holdets sejr. Derudover deltog hun i det invitation-only Augusta National Women’s Amateur, en af golfens mest prestigefyldte amatørturneringer.

Holdet omkring Madsen har også leveret stærke præstationer, hvilket afspejles i hendes individuelle succes. Med tre sejre i løbet af sæsonen var hun med til at sikre holdet en solid placering i konkurrencen, selvom universitetets hjemmeside ikke oplyser om den samlede holdplacering.

## Næste skridt

Madsen vender nu blikket frem mod den kommende sæson, der indledes den 7.-8. september 2026 med Cougar Classic på Yeamans Hall Club i Hanahan, South Carolina. For den danske junior er det en chance for at bygge videre på sin imponerende karriere og fortsætte jagten på endnu større præstationer. Med sin seneste udtagelse til ANNIKA Award Watch List har hun allerede vist, at hun hører til blandt de bedste i landet – og hun har potentiale til at tage endnu et skridt fremad i den nye sæson.

For NC State’s golfhold bliver Madsen fortsat en central spiller, der kan trække holdet med sig i konkurrencen. Med hendes erfaring, stabilitet og evne til at præstere under pres, vil hun uden tvivl spille en afgørende rolle i holdets jagten på endnu flere sejre.

Illinois Springfield equalised through Gentil Selemani, who levelled the score at 1-1 before the break, but UAH regained the lead in the second half.

title: Darcy Moffat scores twice on Florida Southern season opener
original:
British striker Darcy Moffat made an immediate impact as Florida Southern opened their 2026 soccer season with a commanding 4-0 victory over Barton on Friday evening.

## Moffat’s brace sets the tone

Moffat, a senior from London, England, scored twice to lead the Mocs to a resounding start to the campaign. The forward converted both of his shots on goal, including a strike from three-quarters of the pitch in the 89th minute that sealed the win. His first goal, assisted by Luciano Schiaffini in the 46th minute, extended Florida Southern’s lead to 3-0, while his second unassisted strike saw the Barton goalkeeper off his line.

The university’s athletics website reports that Moffat’s brace marked his fifth for Florida Southern in a single match, a milestone that underscored his importance to the team’s attacking output. The victory represented the most goals and largest margin of victory in a season opener since 2018, adding further significance to the performance.

## Team performance and context

Florida Southern dominated the match, recording eight shots on goal to Barton’s five and registering 16 total shots compared to their opponents’ nine. The Mocs also enjoyed a slight edge in corners (3-2) and held a clean sheet, with goalkeeper making five saves. Both teams committed nine fouls, reflecting a competitive but fair encounter.

The match report highlights that this was the first occasion since 2022 that two different Florida Southern players had scored twice in the same game, following a 5-0 win over Atlantis University. Schiaffini’s involvement in Moffat’s first goal added to the sense of cohesion in the team’s attacking play, while the late strike from the British forward provided a fitting climax to the evening.

## Looking ahead

With the season now underway, Moffat and his teammates will aim to build on this strong opening performance. The senior’s form in front of goal will be crucial as Florida Southern look to challenge for postseason honours in NCAA Division II. The Mocs’ next fixtures will test their early-season momentum, but Friday’s result offers a promising start to the campaign.
